title: Docusign Standard to self-hosted OpenSign
summary: Five seats of Docusign is $1,800 a year. The cost is not the hard part of this decision — the evidence trail is.

you_lose: Docusign's name on the audit trail, which carries weight in a dispute
Two decades of procurement acceptance and legal precedent
Managed identity verification and certificate handling
you_gain: Signed documents on infrastructure you control
No envelope limits at any team size

caveats: Signature validity depends on your jurisdiction and on the evidence you can produce. A technically sound audit trail and one the other side's lawyers accept are different things.
You supply your own signing certificate, and a trusted one is a cost this page does not include.
For contracts where the amount at stake dwarfs $1,800 a year, we would stay on Docusign and consider the difference an insurance premium.
